question.text: Accounting basis for PMS performance calculation (per SEBI) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Accrual + fair-value recognition. Realised and unrealised components aggregated for TWRR. The Trap: Pure cash basis would defer reporting. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A covers. Manager's Pro-Tip: Third-party fund administrators can provide fair-value accounting — reduces disputes.
